_note: Wand Lab test dummies (first six from the design doc). category drives Bite and element multipliers. immune = element tags that deal 0.

dummies.name: Straw Dummy
dummies.behavior: Stands still; shows a live damage log

dummies.name: Stone Sentinel
dummies.behavior: Heavy shell absorbs 75% of damage until cracked; Earth and armor-break hit the shell at full strength

dummies.name: Iron Knight
dummies.behavior: A ward bubble absorbs all damage until broken; Ward Bite (Cold Iron) and Earth break it fast

dummies.name: Wisp Lantern
dummies.behavior: Floats and bobs; phases out (immune) 1.5 s of every 4 s

dummies.name: Treant Stump
dummies.behavior: Regrows 25 health per second unless burning

dummies.name: Ember Golem
dummies.behavior: Immune to Fire; forces a second element
